findings.title: Core validator port is correct and parity-tested against the original script
findings.description: `requiredHeadings`, `documentHeadingKeys`, and `missingHeadings` reproduce the bash script's matching semantics (verified line-by-line against `scripts/validate-slice-design`): marker on the next line, level equality plus normalized prefix match, fenced-code skipping, `{placeholder}` prefix cut. Unit tests cover case/whitespace/comment/parenthetical leniency, level mismatch, fences, CRLF, template order, and a no-marker template; the file-layer test pins the real template's required list (non-empty, includes `## Overview` and `### Verification Walkthrough`) so a template-format change fails loudly instead of passing everything.

findings.title: CLI command preserves the script's output and exit-code contract, worktree-aware
findings.description: `resolveTemplatePath` uses `resolveProjectWorktree` + `resolveOperationPath` exactly like `validate frontmatter` does for its document root, so the invoking worktree's own guide copy is used (verified against `resolveWorktreeForPath`'s longest-root semantics; the test uses two registered worktrees and asserts the template path flips when cwd is in the worktree). Empty-arg, missing-file, directory, and unreadable-file cases all throw `SliceDesignValidationError` before any result is produced and route through `handleError(err, 2)`, keeping exit 2 with empty stdout in both human and `--json` modes; the optional `[files...]` argument declaration with an in-action empty check is the documented way to avoid Commander's exit-1 usage error.

findings.title: Test suite exercises the real boundary behavior per testing rules
findings.description: Only `FileProjectStore` (a real-disk collaborator) is mocked; the real core validator, real guide template, and four real slice designs run end-to-end through Commander, covering pass, single missing heading, docType failure, mixed ordering, the full JSON contract, all six exit-2 cases × human/json, the missing-template `cf guides update` message, and worktree template selection. File-level tests in `packages/core/tests/schema/sliceDesignFiles.test.ts` add the unreadable-file case (properly `skipIf` conditioned on root/Windows) and the all-files-preflight guarantee. This matches the design's Success Criteria item-for-item.

findings.title: Conventions and typing rules followed
findings.description: Exports are split correctly (pure validator from `@context-forge/core`, fs layer from `@context-forge/core/node`) mirroring the frontmatter pair; `SLICE_DESIGN_TEMPLATE_RELATIVE_PATH` is defined once beside `GUIDE_RELATIVE_PATH` and exported through both guide entry points; the const-object `DesignFailureReason` centralizes the failure reason per the "define once" rule; no `any`, no `as` assertions in source (the one `as never` in the CLI test mocks `process.exit` and is commented); file sizes (107/127/83 lines) and function lengths stay well under the project limits. The `ValidateDesignJson` contract is documented and matches the design's JSON spec exactly.

structured_findings.summary: Core validator port is correct and parity-tested against the original script
CLI command preserves the script's output and exit-code contract, worktree-aware
Test suite exercises the real boundary behavior per testing rules
